summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only — no files changed)  I traced the full watchlist path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`, plus `useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx`, and the auth cookie handlers.
